name: Lindsey Medical Supply
old_description: How Lindsey Medical Supply is Changing Lives: Real Stories from Our Customers
about:
Lindsey Medical Supply operates two showrooms in the Oklahoma City metro area, with locations in Oklahoma City and Norman, Oklahoma. The business was founded by the Lindsey family and remains family-owned, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company began as a local source for home medical equipment and supplies, aiming to help individuals and families maintain independence at home.

The retailer stocks a broad range of durable medical equipment, including power scooters, power and manual wheelchairs, rollators, walkers, canes, and over 50 lift chairs in various positions, fabrics, and sizes. It also carries respiratory and CPAP supplies such as CPAP machines, masks, nebulizers, and portable oxygen concentrators, along with hospital beds, mattresses, bed rails, and daily living aids like bath safety products, incontinence supplies, and wound care items. In-house technicians provide repair services for mobility equipment and lift chairs, and the company offers equipment rentals and insurance assistance.

Lindsey Medical Supply serves individuals and families across the Oklahoma City metropolitan area who need mobility solutions, respiratory equipment, and daily living aids. Its customers include seniors, people with disabilities, and caregivers seeking products for home recovery and long-term care. The company partners with manufacturers such as Pride Mobility, Golden Technologies, Invacare, ResMed, Inogen, and Bruno to supply branded equipment.

The company emphasizes local expertise, with staff who understand the specific needs of Oklahoma families, and a commitment to complete support from purchase through repair. Its differentiators include two physical showrooms for hands-on product trials, in-house repair capabilities, and a focus on helping customers find equipment that fits their lifestyle, home, and budget.
